message: 記号と再生産
Now then, it's Monday after school. I need to hurry to the Student Council room and decide on this week's activity guidelines.

name: Misa
message: 「Well, today is Monday, after all. I'll get to the Student Council room ahead of Sakura-kun and decide this week's activity plan myself!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Since we're both heading there, wanna go together?」

name: Misa
message: 「Teehee, no way in hell.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, you don't have to run away.」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyah!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Whoa there!?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm sorry, I was in such a hurry... Wait, it's just you, Shio!」

name: Shio
message: 「The fault is mine as well, for I was in quite a rush... Oh, my! Elder Sister!!」

name: Shio
message: 「How fortuitous. I was just searching for you, Elder Sister. Pray accept this notebook.」

name: Misa
message: 「What's this?」

name: Shio
message: 「Did we not speak of it during our recent sleepover? Inspired by you, Elder Sister, I too have penned a novel!」

name: Misa
message: 「My, you finished it! Good for you. Finishing what you start is the most important thing, after all.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ahem! Come, come, by all means, please peruse this humble effort.」

name: Shio
message: 「As it is a tale into which I poured my very soul, it will take nearly an hour to read even at top speed. In the meantime, might we partake of some tea at Prier?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, I'll head on ahead--」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Wait right there! You want to go to the Student Council room with me, don't you!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... but it's gonna take nearly an hour, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll finish it in under five minutes.」

name: Shio
message: 「That is quite impossible. Come, come, please give it a read.」

name: Misa
message: 「...Shio, before I turn the cover, let me ask you one thing: what genre is this story?」

name: Shio
message: 「It is a modern battle-academy fantasy romance neo-horror.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't tell me the protagonists are a prince in disguise, an apprentice mage, and a sentient sword?」

name: Shio
message: 「*Flinch*」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen closely, Shio? As the absolute basics, starting with an alarm clock, opening with a poem, or having the protagonist introduce themselves right away all lose points, okay?」

name: Shio
message: 「*F-Flinch*」

name: Misa
message: 「Next, just to check, the prologue doesn't start with a voice from another world before they suddenly find themselves there, or have them pass out and wake up in a parallel world, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「For fantasy elements, a cherry-tree spirit or a rabbit leading into an Alice parody is a no-go, okay? Espers, psychics, and supernatural detective agencies are strictly out too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, of course that includes onmyoji, too?」

name: Shio
message: 「*F-F-Flinch!*」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan?」

name: Shio
message: 「G-Guhii... H-However, Elder Sister, even if the developments are cliche, so long as it depicts a romance that transcends social status, would that not earn a passing grade?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, that's right. However...」

name: Misa
message: 「Episodes where someone protects their crush or takes the hit for them from a flying ball, a runaway car, or shattering glass from said car are totally played out for readers, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「*Flinch-flinch, flinch-flinch!*」

name: Misa
message: 「And forbidden love? Don't tell me a conglomerate heir who grew up unloved by his parents ends up living with a kid he picked up off the street?」

name: Misa
message: 「And having love sparked by crossdressing for a school festival play or as a stand-in at a marriage meeting is completely out of the question, okay?」

name: Shio
message: 「*Flinch-flinch-flinch, flinch-flinch-flinch!!*」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa... She just hacked it to pieces without a shred of mercy...」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I shall... take my leave and start anew... P-Please return my notebook...!」

name: Misa
message: 「No, I'll hold onto this for now. Let me give you my proper thoughts on it the next time I come over for a sleepover.」

name: Shio
message: 「Y-You really needn't... trouble yourself reading... such trash...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio, everyone starts out there, okay? Don't let something like this discourage you--let's both do our best!」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister... Yes, I shall devote myself to improving... Now then, if you'll excuse me...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, it hasn't even been five minutes yet, has it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yeah.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Scary... When she's hysterical, she's scarier than a Demon General.」

name: Synn
message: 「She gave credit where it was due and encouraged her at the end, though...」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio is my little sister, you know? That's why I deliberately withheld flattery and gave her my harsh opinion.」

name: Synn
message: 「I get that. Still, wouldn't it have been better to actually read it first?」

name: Misa
message: 「...Sakura-kun, even if it's just until we reach the Student Council room, do you want to try reading it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it looks interesting.」
On the way to the old school building, I skim through Shio-chan's debut work.
I've only looked at the very beginning, yet the content is exactly as Misa pointed out...
